messages:
From: Samantha Mills <samantha@finscale.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-09T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Question: retention tiers + tracing dashboard pricing for enterprise

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the tracing UI looked promising. We need to finalize internal budgeting this week. Two quick asks:

- Can you send the slab pricing for retention (30/90/365 days) for logs/trace spans and the unit assumptions behind each slab? We want to model cost at 100M vs 500M tokens/month.
- Second, what's included in the "Advanced Dashboards" add-on? Does it include custom alerting, saved queries, and a seat-based dashboard editor, or is that separate?

We may be able to commit to a 12-month contract if we can get a predictable SKU and a concession on the observability add-ons. Attaching the procurement calendar for context.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Mills
Head of Platform
Finscale
[attachment: finscale_procurement_schedule.xlsx (Excel)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Mills <samantha@finscale.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-09T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Question: retention tiers + tracing dashboard pricing for enterprise

Hi Samantha — great to hear from you. Appreciate the procurement timeline. Quick answers and a proposal below.

1) Retention slab pricing (summary):
- 30d: $0.006 /k tokens
- 90d: $0.0045 /k tokens
- 365d: $0.0032 /k tokens
(Prices assume continuous prefix caching and KV compression; detailed assumptions attached.)

2) Advanced Dashboards add-on: includes:
- Unlimited saved views for up to 25 dashboard editors (seat-based upgrade beyond 25)
- Alerting rules (up to 100 active alerts) and webhook/actions
- Query templates and scheduled exports
- Integrated trace/span correlation (no additional charge up to the purchased retention slab)

Given your volumes, if you commit to 12 months at the 500M tokens/month profile we can offer:
- 15% discount on the retention slab pricing above, plus
- 3 months of Advanced Dashboards at no charge (billed pro-rata after month 3)

I'm attaching the formal retention slab PDF and a draft concession outline. Ben and Priyom are looped in to finalize commercials and contract steps.

Best,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
[attachment: retention_slab_v2.pdf (PDF)]

Laura — thanks for the fast reply and the numbers. Couple of follow-ups from procurement and finance:

- Finance would like a further concession if we sign a 12-month committed spend: can you move the discount to 20% on the 365d slab?
- Procurement asked whether the alerting webhook capacity is included or metered separately. If it's metered, what's the overage rate?

We can also consider a 9-month ramp (start smaller, scale to 500M) if that helps discounts. Open to a conversation tomorrow morning PT.

Samantha

Subject: Counterproposal: committed 12mo concession for Finscale

Samantha — appreciate the clarity. I've reviewed with Rev Ops and Pricing. Proposed commercial concession we can commit to:

- 12-month committed spend (starting from go-live): 18% discount off the 365d slab price (applies only to baseline committed volume).
- If Finscale hits a sustained >450M tokens/month for two consecutive months, we’ll increase to 22% for the remainder of the term.
- Alerting webhooks: included up to 200k webhook events/month; overage: $0.00015 per event.
- Advanced Dashboards: first 3 months complimentary, then $2,500/mo. For enterprise customization (templates + onboarding) we can include a one-time enablement credit of $6,000.

Attached is a redline of the commercial tab and a short note describing how we calculate committed baseline and catch-up credits.

If that sounds close, I’ll formalize a short SOW and send to procurement for signature (DocuSign).

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
